scope: Checked Parquet logical value roles and explicit nested native schema projection; retained native bytes and ideal recovery, PyArrow 21.0.0 and Chromium 148 evidence

regression.scope: All tests/core, tests/core-ideals, tests/postgresql, tests/sqlserver, tests/tablespec, tests/avro and tests/parquet test files except field-conformance.test.ts and nullability-conformance.test.ts, both run separately after evidence refresh.

criteria.AC1: Classification and projection tests cover positive, refusal, approximation, unknown, nested/cyclic items and both recovery directions
criteria.AC2: Pinned native combined command runs schema/value counterexamples and composed fresh ingestion/classification/recovery checks
criteria.AC3: Real Chromium reproduces classification/projection receipts and both JSON/YAML recovery directions without host globals or external requests; native codecs independently verify generated candidate schemas
criteria.AC4: All schemas pass audit; item references, independent availability, unknown metadata and strict/report boundaries have explicit tests

limits: Five qualified bindings do not replace the separate Cardinality ideal admission/all-five conformance gate.
Classification concerns checked present-value roles; wrappers, key-only maps and unannotated repetition remain unresolved without explicit interpretation.
Projection emits empty native schema files from explicit bounded carriers; it does not convert arbitrary row data.
MAP uniqueness and non-string keys remain residuals; shape/scalar families do not prove value exactness, including binary32 narrowing.
Native-only reclassification need not recover author intent; retained receipts recover it.
Embedded Arrow refinements, unknown content and original physical bytes are retained independently; no implicit record associations or default execution.
Regression scope is core and five priority systems, not the full repository.

documentationRevalidations.reason: Publish separate Cardinality ideal-admission and qualified five-system delivery gate; executable libraries, schemas and native/browser proofs unchanged. Predecessor gates rerun when their evidence references changed.
